name: 61072 · Rockton, IL
findings: ZIP 61072 (Rockton) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61072 (Rockton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 61072 (Rockton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
